# Code of Conduct

We follow the Contributor Covenant 2.1.

## Our Pledge

We pledge to make participation in our community a harassment-free experience for everyone, regardless of age, body size, visible or invisible disability, ethnicity, sex, gender identity, gender expression, level of experience, education, socio-economic status, nationality, personal appearance, race, religion, or sexual identity and orientation.

## Enforcement

Report violations to lvyaoyuan168@gmail.com. Maintainer lvyuan1688 enforces.
